correctness.rationale: For the symmetric reflexive overlap relation P, the identity P³=P means closed intents are precisely polarity images. Every pairwise-intersecting family of K_n edges either lies in a star or is a triangle, yielding a star/unions variant; when a disjoint edge pair is present the polar is contained in the four cross edges of a 4-cycle and every subset is realized by opposite-edge blockers. These cases give exactly the listed eleven shapes and the formula 2+2C(n,2)+C(C(n,2),2)+C(n,3)+15C(n,4)+n+nC(n−1,2). For n=4 all 2^6 edge subsets close, so the lattice is Boolean with S6 automorphisms. For n>=5 the number of third closed edges paired with intersecting vs disjoint edges is respectively 2n−5 vs 4, recovering the line graph, maximal stars, and S_n. The explicit modularity counterexample X={01,02}, Y={34}, Z=S0 proves nonmodularity for n>=5. Independently exhausted n=4,5,6 closures and checked all counts. These are exact for all n, with finite checks supplementary.
